standing: Candidates of a path extends specifier are formed from the normalized path N as TypeScript 6.0.3's getExtendsConfigPath does: N alone when N ends in .json, otherwise N then N followed by .json. N equal to the project root is unresolved. The scope gate decided on N decides both candidates. M3-B r10 and DISCOVERY-FLAGS-E1a r4 are not edited.
